title: Tustin Trails Golf Course

blurb: Tustin Trails, established in 1998, is an environmentally friendly course with a challenging design that appeals to all levels of play. This well-manicured nine hole, par 35 course features rolling bluegrass fairways and bent grass greens framed by Michigan hardwoods. A winding stream and numerous ponds add to the beauty and challenge of the course.
